### Jami tic pa Lapwony (🎓 Tools)
• **Symbol Studio**: Yub jami me konyo ki alama me kit AAC ki pingo cawa ma nen.
• **BehaviorLens**: Nen ki ngiyo kit kwo i kit ma kiyubo maber.
• **Report Writer**: Coy ngec me apim ki mede anyim.
• **Document Remediation**: Tii ki folder me PDF ducu i wang acel ki yo me accessibility.
### Jami me Pwony (🧠 Learn)
• **STEAM Lab**: Simulation me science, kwan kit, ki engineering ma latin kwan twero timo kwede.
• **StoryForge**: Yub lok aduya kacel ma yero gin ma time.
• **SEL Hub**: Tic me pwony me bedo kacel ki tam cwiny, ki penyo kit ma latin kwan tye kwede.
• **Research Hub**: Tic me yeny ngec ma kimiyo yo ki pimo ka ma ngec oa iye.
acholi.brainstormInsert:
### Discussion Kit Mode
• **Protocols**: Think-Pair-Share, Socratic Seminar, Fishbowl, onyo Gallery Walk.
• **Lapenyo ma Kimedo Rwom**: Lwak lapenyo ma lero, ma mito tamo, ki ma pimo, ma oa i jami mamegi.
• **Acakki me Lok**: Acakki me lok pi latin kwan me ye, kwero, lero, ki medo tam.
• **Jami ma Lapwony Ocoyo**: Cawa me telo, peko ma twero time, ki gin ma nen ni latin kwan tye ka donyo iye (lapwony keken).
### Jigsaw Mode
• **Paket pa Lalony**: Jami kipoko i dul ma gimito kekengi, dul acel pi lwak lalony acel acel.
• **Kadi me Pwonyo Cen**: Poin ma pire tek ki lapenyo me ngiyo ma lalony acel acel tiyo kwede me pwonyo dul mamegi.
• **Ngiyo Tic**: Lapenyo manok me gam ma lero ma opoko jami ducu, ki lagam pi lapwony keken.

chin_falam.actionsSuffix:
### Sayama hna caah Tool hna (🎓 Tools)
• **Symbol Studio**: AAC-style symbol bawmhnak le hmuh theih caan cazin tuah.
• **BehaviorLens**: Ziaza kha hmanthlak tein zoh le thleidang.
• **Report Writer**: Zohfelnak le changcho thawngthanhnak draft tuah.
• **Document Remediation**: Accessibility pipeline hmangin PDF folder pakhat batch in tuah.
### Cawnnak Tool hna (🧠 Learn)
• **STEAM Lab**: Sianginn ngakchia nih an hman kho mi science, math le engineering simulation.
• **StoryForge**: Tlangtlaknak le duhthlannak in hruai mi thuanthu tuahnak.
• **SEL Hub**: Social-emotional cawnnak hnathawhnak le dinhmun zohfelnak.
• **Research Hub**: Hruainak ngei thilhlan le source zohfelnak hnathawhnak.
chin_falam.brainstormInsert:
### Reltlangnak Kit Mode
• **Protocol hna**: Think-Pair-Share, Socratic Seminar, Fishbowl, asilole Gallery Walk.
• **A sang in Biahalnak hna**: Na source in lak mi literal, inference le evaluation biahalnak pawl.
• **Reltlangnak Thawkhnak**: Sianginn ngakchia pawl lungtlai, lungtlai lo, fiangter le ruahnak chap khawhnak caah thumal thawkhnak.
• **Sayama Cakuat**: Facilitation caan, harsatnak le telvenak hmuhmi (sayama view lawng).
### Jigsaw Mode
• **Expert Packet hna**: Source kha a pehtlai mi cheu hna ah then, expert group tin caah cheu pakhat.
• **Teach-Back Card hna**: Expert tin nih an inn group an cawnpiaknak caah hman mi a biapi bik le zohfelnak biahalnak.
• **Responsibility Zohfelnak**: Cheu vialte a huap mi free-response biahalnak tawite, sayama lawng caah answer key ngei.

karen.actionsSuffix:
### သရၣ်အတၢ်ပီးတၢ်လီတဖၣ် (🎓 Tools)
• **Symbol Studio**: ဘှီထီၣ် AAC-style အတၢ်မၤစၢၤအပနီၣ်တဖၣ် ဒီးတၢ်ရဲၣ်တၢ်ကျဲၤလၢထံၣ်အီၤသ့.
• **BehaviorLens**: ကွၢ်ထွဲဒီးပဲာ်ထံနီၤဖးတၢ်အိၣ်မူအိၣ်ဂဲၤလၢအိၣ်ဒီးတၢ်ရဲၣ်တၢ်ကျဲၤ.
• **Report Writer**: ကွဲးတၢ်ပာ်ဖျါလၢတၢ်သမံသမိးဒီးတၢ်လဲၤထီၣ်လဲၤထီအဂီၢ်.
• **Document Remediation**: မၤ PDF folder တဖျၢၣ်လၢ batch ပူၤခီဖျိ accessibility pipeline.
### တၢ်မၤလိအတၢ်ပီးတၢ်လီတဖၣ် (🧠 Learn)
• **STEAM Lab**: Science, math ဒီး engineering simulation တဖၣ်လၢကၠိဖိမၤကွၢ်အီၤသ့.
• **StoryForge**: ဘှီထီၣ်တၢ်တဲပူပေါင်းဖှိၣ်လၢတၢ်ဃုထၢဟံးစုနဲၣ်ကျဲအီၤ.
• **SEL Hub**: Social-emotional တၢ်မၤလိအတၢ်ဟူးတၢ်ဂဲၤ ဒီးတၢ်သမံသမိးတၢ်အိၣ်ဆူၣ်အိၣ်ချ့.
• **Research Hub**: တၢ်ဃုသ့ၣ်ညါလၢအိၣ်ဒီးတၢ်ဟံးစုနဲၣ်ကျဲ ဒီးတၢ်သမံသမိး source တဖၣ်.
karen.brainstormInsert:
### တၢ်တဲသကိး Kit Mode
• **တၢ်သိၣ်တၢ်သီအကျိၤအကျဲတဖၣ်**: Think-Pair-Share, Socratic Seminar, Fishbowl မ့တမ့ၢ် Gallery Walk.
• **တၢ်သံကွၢ်လၢအအိၣ်ဒီးအပတီၢ်တဖၣ်**: တၢ်သံကွၢ်အခီပညီတီတီ, တၢ်ဆိကမိၣ်ထီၣ် ဒီးတၢ်သမံသမိးလၢဟဲလၢန source.
• **တၢ်ကတိၤအခီၣ်ထံးတဖၣ်**: ကၠိဖိအဂီၢ်တၢ်ကတိၤစးထီၣ်လၢတၢ်ဘၣ်လိာ်, တဘၣ်လိာ်, ပာ်ဖျါထီၣ် ဒီးမၤဒိၣ်ထီၣ်တၢ်ဆိကမိၣ်.
• **သရၣ်အတၢ်မၤနီၣ်တဖၣ်**: တၢ်ဟံးစုနဲၣ်ကျဲအဆၢကတီၢ်, တၢ်ကီတၢ်ခဲ ဒီးတၢ်ပၣ်ဃုာ်အတၢ်ပနီၣ်တဖၣ် (သရၣ်အတၢ်ထံၣ်အပူၤဧိၤ).
### Jigsaw Mode
• **ပှၤသ့ပှၤဘၣ် Packet တဖၣ်**: Source ဘၣ်တၢ်နီၤဖးအီၤလၢအကူာ်လၢအဒိးသန့ၤထီၣ်အသးလၢတဂၤဒီးတဂၤ, တကူာ်လၢ expert group တဖုအဂီၢ်.
• **တၢ်သိၣ်က့ၤ Card တဖၣ်**: တၢ်ဂ့ၢ်မိၢ်ပှၢ် ဒီးတၢ်သံကွၢ်သမံသမိးလၢ expert တဂၤစုာ်စုာ်သူဝဲလၢကသိၣ်အ home group.
• **တၢ်သမံသမိးမူဒါ**: တၢ်သံကွၢ် free-response ဖုၣ်ဖုၣ်လၢဘၣ်ထွဲဒီးအကူာ်ခဲလၢာ်, ဃုာ်ဒီး answer key လၢသရၣ်အဂီၢ်ဧိၤ.

lingala.actionsSuffix:
### Bisaleli ya Balakisi (🎓 Tools)
• **Symbol Studio**: Salá lisungi ya bilembo na ndenge ya AAC mpe manaka ya komonana.
• **BehaviorLens**: Talá mpe sekolá ezalela na ndenge ebongisami.
• **Report Writer**: Komá liboso lapolo ya botali mpe bokoli.
• **Document Remediation**: Salá na mbala moko dosie ya PDF na nzela ya accessibilité.
### Bisaleli ya Koyekola (🧠 Learn)
• **STEAM Lab**: Masano ya komekola ya science, matematiki mpe ingénierie oyo bayekoli bakoki kosalela.
• **StoryForge**: Kotonga masolo elongo, oyo maponi etambwisaka.
• **SEL Hub**: Misala ya boyekoli ya bomoi na bato mpe mayoki, mpe botali ndenge bazali.
• **Research Hub**: Misala ya boluki ekambami mpe botali ya maziba.
lingala.brainstormInsert:
### Lolenge ya Kit ya Masolo
• **Baprotokole**: Think-Pair-Share, Socratic Seminar, Fishbowl, to Gallery Walk.
• **Mituna ya Bitape**: Bituluku ya mituna ya polele, ya kososola mpe ya kotala, oyo euti na liziba na yo.
• **Ebandeli ya Maloba**: Ebandeli ya bafraze mpo bayekoli bandima, baboya, balimbola mpe bakolisa makanisi.
• **Bakomi ya Molakisi**: Tango ya kokamba, mikakatano mpe bilembo ya bosangani (emonani kaka na molakisi).
### Lolenge ya Jigsaw
• **Bapaketi ya Bato ya Mayele**: Liziba ekabolami na biteni oyo etalelanaka, eteni moko mpo na etuluku moko na moko ya bato ya mayele.
• **Bakarte ya Koteya Lisusu**: Makanisi ya ntina mpe mituna ya botali oyo moto ya mayele asalelaka mpo na koteya etuluku na ye ya ebandeli.
• **Botali ya Mokumba**: Mituna mikuse ya eyano ya bonsomi oyo etali eteni nyonso, na fungola ya biyano mpo na molakisi kaka.

marshallese.actionsSuffix:
### Kein jerbal ñan Rūkaki (🎓 Tools)
• **Symbol Studio**: Kōṃṃan kein jipañ kōn symbol ilo wāwein AAC im schedule ko rej walok.
• **BehaviorLens**: Lale im etale Ṃwilin ilo juon wāwein eo eṃōj kōṃṃane.
• **Report Writer**: Je draft in ripoot ko an assessment im progress.
• **Document Remediation**: Jerbale juon folder in PDF ko ippān doon ilo accessibility pipeline.
### Kein jerbal in Katak (🧠 Learn)
• **STEAM Lab**: Interactive simulation ko ikijjien science, math, im engineering me rūkkatak ro remaroñ jerbal kaki.
• **StoryForge**: Kōṃṃan bwebwenato ippān doon im an option ko tel.
• **SEL Hub**: Jerbal ko an social-emotional learning im check-in ko.
• **Research Hub**: Jerbal ko an guided research im etale source ko.
marshallese.brainstormInsert:
### Wāwein Discussion Kit
• **Protocol ko**: Think-Pair-Share, Socratic Seminar, Fishbowl, ak Gallery Walk.
• **Kajjitōk ko ilo Level ko**: Kajjitōk ko rej literal, inference, im evaluation jen source eo am.
• **Jinoin Kōnono ko**: Jinoin sentence ko ñan an rūkkatak errā, jab errā, kōmeḷeḷe, im kalōñḷọk idea ko.
• **Jeje ko an Rūkaki**: Iien facilitation, problem ko, im men ko ñan lale participation (teacher view wōt).
### Jigsaw Mode
• **Packet ko an Ri-jeḷā**: Source eo ej jebar ñan part ko rej aikuji doon, juon part ñan kajjojo expert group.
• **Teach-Back Card ko**: Point ko raurok im kajjitōk ko an kajjojo ri-jeḷā kōjerbali ñan katakin home group eo an.
• **Accountability Check**: Kajjitōk ko redik im free-response rej kōn aolep part ko, ippān answer key ñan rūkaki wōt.
